servinfo.title: Brake Stroke Sensor Zero Point Reset

attention3.ptxt: In the ECM memory, the released position of brake pedal is defined as the zero point, which serves as a benchmark of the brake stroke amount. Since this zero point will change if any of the following service is performed, a zero point initialization must be performed.

item.ptxt: Removal/installation or replacement of brake stroke sensor

s1.ptxt: Set ignition “OFF”, connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC.
Set ignition “ON” and execute “Brake Stroke Sensor Zero Point Initialization” in “Utility” mode of ECM on SUZUKI scan tool.
Set ignition “OFF”, disconnect SUZUKI scan tool from DLC.
Release brake pedal. Set ignition “ON” and wait for 5 seconds or more. The zero point is stored in ECM.
